Figure S17 (A-D) – spatial-transcriptomics Z-score heatmaps

Purkinje (A,C) and Granule (B,D) top-20 genes vs gestational age at birth (A,B) and chronological age at death (C,D)

2026-08-06 15:30:33

Overview

Panels A-D are Z-scored spatial-transcriptomics gene-expression heatmaps across the 8 post-mortem cerebellar samples, for the two neuronal populations:

Panel Cells Ordered / labelled by
A Purkinje gestational age at birth (26-40 wk)
B Granule gestational age at birth
C Purkinje chronological age at death (9-20 wk)
D Granule chronological age at death

Reproducibility note. The sample-averaged Z-score matrices (Dataset_SpatialTx_ZScores.xlsx sheets PC_zScore, GC_zScore) and the 8-sample age metadata (sheet sample_meta) are the local outputs of the CoGAPS/spatial-transcriptomics pipeline; these panels are rebuilt here from those files. The per-gene linear-model coefficients used for panels E/F (and for the top-20 gene selection) come from the version15 lmer pipeline that reads the raw Seurat object on the <data_path> server (seepipeline_code_EF/`, do-not-edit) — those are not locally regenerable, so the gene lists below are taken from that pipeline’s output (the deck) and the Z-scores are read from local data.

Data

WB17 <- find_s17("Dataset_SpatialTx_ZScores.xlsx")     # consolidated: sample_meta + PC/GC z-score sheets
read_z <- function(sheet) {
 m <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(WB17, sheet = sheet))
 names(m)[1] <- "Gene"
 m
}
PC <- read_z("PC_zScore")
GC <- read_z("GC_zScore")
meta <- readxl::read_excel(WB17, sheet = "sample_meta") %>%
 mutate(sample = as.character(sample),
 chron = Age_at_death_wk - GA_birth_wk) # chronological age at death (weeks lived)

Heatmap builder (deck style)

# order_col: "GA_birth_wk" (columns by gestational age at birth) or "chron" (chronological age at death)
build_hm <- function(mat, genes, order_col, x_title) {
 ord <- meta %>% arrange(.data[[order_col]])
 samp <- ord$sample
 labs_x <- as.character(round(ord[[order_col]]))

 long <- mat %>% filter(Gene %in% genes) %>%
 select(Gene, all_of(samp)) %>%
 pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "Z") %>%
 mutate(xi = match(sample, samp),
 Gene = factor(Gene, levels = rev(genes)))

 ggplot(long, aes(xi, Gene, fill = Z)) +
 geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
 midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2.5, 2.5),
 name = "Z-score", breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)) +
 scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(samp), labels = labs_x,
 expand = c(0, 0), position = "top") +
 labs(x = x_title, y = NULL) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
 axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
 axis.title.x.top = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(b = 4)),
 panel.grid = element_blank(),
 legend.key.height = unit(0.7, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(0.28, "cm"),
 legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5), legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
 plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
}
save_panel <- function(p, stem) {
 ggsave(paste0(stem, ".pdf"), p, width = 90, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf)
}

Panel A – Purkinje, gestational age at birth

pA <- build_hm(PC, genes_A, "GA_birth_wk", "Gestational age at birth (weeks)")
print(pA); save_panel(pA, "Figure_S17A_Purkinje_GAbirth")

Panel B – Granule, gestational age at birth

pB <- build_hm(GC, genes_B, "GA_birth_wk", "Gestational age at birth (weeks)")
print(pB); save_panel(pB, "Figure_S17B_Granule_GAbirth")

Panel C – Purkinje, chronological age at death

pC <- build_hm(PC, genes_C, "chron", "Post-menstrual at death (weeks)")
print(pC); save_panel(pC, "Figure_S17C_Purkinje_AgeAtDeath")

Panel D – Granule, chronological age at death

pD <- build_hm(GC, genes_D, "chron", "Post-menstrual at death (weeks)")
print(pD); save_panel(pD, "Figure_S17D_Granule_AgeAtDeath")

Panels E/F (server-only)

Panels E (PC) and F (GC) plot each gene’s gestational-age-at-birth coefficient against its age-at-death coefficient from the version15 lmer models. Those coefficients are produced by pipeline_code_EF/linear_model_subsetSamples{PC,GC}.R, which read the raw Seurat object from <data_path> and are therefore **not locally regenerable** (only the Purkinje GA-coefficient table is available locally). They are shipped as do-not-edit code plus (pending) the rendered panels from the server pipeline — see_provenance.md`.
